# Template design & integration docs

One document per builder-first template — design rationale, node map,
3D mechanics where applicable, guide compliance and manual verification
steps. The hard rules every template must satisfy live in
[`../template-adapter-guide.md`](../template-adapter-guide.md)
(step-by-step adaptation + pitfalls 1–12 + pre-ship checklist).

| Template | Doc | Character | Signature |
|---|---|---|---|
| Minimal BW | (predates these docs — see the adapter guide) | Light monochrome | Editorial photo grids |
| Atelier | (predates these docs) | Warm cream, centred | Editorial plates |
| Halcyon | [`../halcyon-followups.md`](../halcyon-followups.md) (fix log) | Warm dark, burnt sienna | Typographic project index |
| Meridian | [`meridian.md`](./meridian.md) | Cool gallery plaster, steel blue | Split hero, museum-hang grid |
| Vernissage | [`vernissage.md`](./vernissage.md) | Night gallery, ink + brass | 3D coverflow showcase |
| Serenata | [`serenata.md`](./serenata.md) | Ivory + rosewood, wedding | 3D page-flip wedding album |

New template? Start from the adapter guide's checklist; add the sibling
`<name>.md` here and a row above.
